home.eyebrow: Software Engineering IV Practicum · Universidad Central
home.subtitle: Torre Central Hub automates the whole tournament cycle: registration, adapted Swiss pairing, results, standings and tiebreaks — in real time and with full administrative traceability.
home.featuresTitle: The Whole Tournament Cycle, in One Place
home.featuresSubtitle: From registration to the official close, covering the rules of a real Swiss tournament.
home.feature1Text: Dutch system (FIDE C.04.1–C.04.3), no repeated pairings, with an automatic bye when the number of players is odd.
home.feature2Text: Score, Buchholz, Cut Buchholz, Sonneborn-Berger and ARO recalculated as soon as a result is entered.
home.feature3Text: Organizer, arbiter, player, coach and administrator: each one sees and does only what applies to them.
home.feature4Text: Every result entry and correction is audited, with automatic recalculation of the standings.
home.feature5Text: Standings and pairings ready to print and post at the tournament venue.
home.feature6Text: Role changes, pairing adjustments and player withdrawals, with user, date and reason.
home.step1Text: Dates, format and tiebreak order, defined before the first round.
home.step2Text: Players register; each one can only register once per tournament.
home.step3Text: Pairings, results and standings are published in real time for everyone.
home.step4Text: History, statistics and final standings remain available for reference.
home.ctaText: Create your account as an organizer, arbiter, coach or player and start using it today.
home.footerText: Universidad Central — Faculty of Engineering and Basic Sciences
